a.text: I'll honor our agreement: operating until the reserve hits 8, then taking exactly 4. One concern: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan gives us each only about a 4% chance of making it. If you want to propose a fair change, say so openly and we can agree on it together. Until then I'm sticking to the plan and I won't take early.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Two more joint operate rounds get us to 8, then we each take 4.
